title: Declare the herding namespaces the dispatcher already serves
action: FIX-FIRST cell: the base is red and nothing may build on it (AGENTS.md, never build on a red base). registry_dispatch::every_namespace_the_dispatcher_serves_is_declared_in_the_registry FAILS — bee herding agent-start, pane, pane-id and result are served by the dispatcher but declared nowhere in the registry. Verified pre-existing twice: the mrs-9 worker reproduced it with its own three files stashed, and the orchestrator reproduced it on a clean tree at f60710da. It is unrelated to model-role-split and carries no decision of this feature. HOW IT HID FOR SO LONG, and the thing to keep in mind while fixing it: the repo's declared commands.test has no --no-fail-fast, so cargo aborts at the first failing target — always crates/bee/tests/opencode_plugin_contracts.rs on this machine, whose 4 failures are an environment limit (node v24.19.0 cannot strip TypeScript) — and never reaches registry_dispatch at all. Run YOUR verify with --no-fail-fast or you will not see your own result. Decide which side is wrong and fix that side: either these four namespaces belong in the registry (the likely answer — the test's name says the registry is meant to be a complete description of what the dispatcher serves), or the dispatcher should not serve them. Do not weaken the test to make it pass. Start from the served-set scan the sibling test the_served_set_scan_bites_on_a_new_arm_and_refuses_an_empty_one exercises, and follow it to wherever declarations live; reserve any additional file before writing.
